issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'מֶתֶג הָאַמָּה' (meteg ha-ammah) is a proper name/place, likely 'Metheg-ammah' (meaning 'the bridle of the mother city' or 'the control of the metropolis'), referring to a city or stronghold, not '一肘尺' (a cubit). The Chinese rendering '一肘尺' misinterprets 'אַמָּה' as a unit of measurement (cubit) rather than as part of a place name, changing the meaning of the verse.
